observations: Two vintage treadle sewing machine tables outdoors on broken concrete
Left table has a blue painted top with a rectangular cutout; right table has a wood-grain laminate top with a cutout
Both have cast iron legs, treadle wheels, and foot pedal assemblies
Photo 2 shows ruler markings along the front edge of the blue top
Photo 3 shows a partial green electric motor in the corner beside the wood table
Watermark text "SESHMAK TECH" and "POSTED ON JIJI" visible across images

claims.evidence: photo 0, photo 1, photo 2, and photo 3 show treadle sewing machine tables with cast iron legs and treadle mechanisms
asking price stated by seller in text, not visible or verifiable in photos

risks.risk: Treadle mechanisms may be rusted, seized, or missing internal parts
risks.proof: video of the treadle wheel turning freely and the foot pedal moving

risks.risk: Table tops may have hidden cracks, rot, water damage, or peeling veneer
risks.proof: close-up photos of both table surfaces, edges, and undersides
risks.if_unproven: as damaged tops requiring repair or replacement

risks.risk: The green motor visible in photo 3 may not be included or may not work
risks.proof: seller confirmation and a video of the motor running
risks.if_unproven: motor excluded or valued as non-working scrap

risks.risk: Buyer may expect complete sewing machines but only legs/bases are shown
risks.proof: photos already show empty cutouts with no machine heads
risks.if_unproven: priced as legs only without sewing heads

proof_requests: Video showing the treadle wheel turning freely and foot pedal moving
Close-up photos of any metal nameplates or stamps on the legs
Confirmation if the green motor in photo 3 is included and in working order
response.reason: The photos clearly identify the items as used treadle sewing machine table legs; even at worst-case condition (rusty, non-functional treadles, damaged tops, no sewing heads), the item type is known and can be priced.
